verses.text: Oh, I wish my head were a spring of water and my eyes a fountain of tears! Then I would weep day and night for my people who have been killed.
Oh, I wish I had a travelers' shelter in the desert! Then I could leave my people and go away from them. For they are all unfaithful, a crowd of traitors.
"They bend their tongues like bows to shoot out lies. They have grown strong in the land, but not by truth. They go from one evil to another, and they do not know me," says the LORD.
"Be careful of your friends. Do not trust even your brother. For every brother cheats, and every friend spreads lies.
Friends deceive each other, and no one speaks the truth. They have trained their tongues to lie. They wear themselves out doing wrong.
You live in the middle of lies. In their lies they refuse to know me," says the LORD.
So this is what the LORD of Armies says: "Look, I will melt them down and test them like metal. What else can I do because of the sin of my people?
Their tongue is a deadly arrow. It speaks lies. With their mouths they speak kindly to their neighbors, but in their hearts they set traps for them.
Should I not punish them for this?" says the LORD. "Should I not take revenge on a nation like this?"

I will weep and cry for the mountains and sing a sad song for the pastures in the wilderness. They are burned and empty, and no one travels through them. The sound of cattle is no longer heard. The birds and the animals have all run away.
"I will make Jerusalem a pile of ruins, a home for jackals. I will make the towns of Judah a wasteland where no one lives."
Who is wise enough to understand this? Who has the LORD spoken to, who can explain it? Why has the land been ruined and burned like a wilderness that no one travels through?
The LORD said, "It is because they have abandoned my law that I gave them. They have not obeyed me or followed my law.
Instead, they have followed their stubborn hearts and the Baals, as their ancestors taught them."
So this is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: "Look, I will make this people eat bitter food and drink poisoned water.
I will scatter them among nations that neither they nor their ancestors have known. I will send the sword after them until I have destroyed them."
This is what the LORD of Armies says: "Think about this! Call for the women who are paid to mourn. Send for the most skilled of them.
Let them come quickly and cry out for us, until our eyes overflow with tears and water streams from our eyelids.
For the sound of crying is heard from Zion: 'How we are ruined! How deeply we are ashamed! We must leave our land, because our homes have been torn down.'"
Now, you women, listen to the word of the LORD. Open your ears to what he says. Teach your daughters how to mourn. Teach one another a song of sorrow.
For death has climbed in through our windows and entered our strong houses. It has taken away the children from the streets and the young men from the town squares.
Say this: "This is what the LORD says: 'Dead bodies will lie like manure in the open field, like grain cut down behind the harvester, with no one to gather them.'"
This is what the LORD says: "Do not let the wise boast about their wisdom, or the strong boast about their strength, or the rich boast about their riches.

But let the one who boasts boast about this: that they understand and know me, that I am the LORD, who shows faithful love, justice, and righteousness on the earth. For these are the things I delight in," says the LORD.
"Look, the days are coming," says the LORD, "when I will punish all who are circumcised only in their bodies:

Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab, and all who live in the desert and cut the hair at the sides of their heads. For all these nations are really uncircumcised, and all the people of Israel are uncircumcised in heart."
